name: E36
_about: E36 cluster, generated by tools/gen_e36.py (edit that and regenerate): the BMW E36 328i cluster of the 90s, traced off face-on photos at true proportions. The EU face (km/h, L/100km) with metric units, the US face (MPH, MPG) with US units. One e36dash shader draws the face, dials, ticks, zones and needles; the printed figures are text widgets. Lamps and turn arrows are never lit (the app cannot read them). BMW's gear letter shows through the right lamp strip. Widget reference: shared/hud.js header.
